description: EN port of PL v4.6 (2026-10-26, nondialogue-unit-data-sysmes) limited to EN-applicable items: (1) save-failure system messages 39944/39967/40006 re-wrapped to <=36 cells with the exact English phrasing unchanged (owner mandate: these messages stay in English; the technical fix is narrower lines, mirroring PL "wezsze linie"); (2) 43894/43897/44010/44013 had wrong English content ("Super Robot Wars Operation Extend." where the Japanese says the game will download the full version) — corrected to "Download the full version." keeping the ledger rule for 43894/44010 (lone "of" prefix kept). NOT ported: the 348 robonote weight/length rows (Polish language-layer translations; the EN panel stays English) and 40068/44704 (already 24 cells, no change).
